tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed las: 'jam dpal zhi sgrub bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ stobs bcu mnga' ba rdzogs sangs rgyas: 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpar 'dud: khams gsum sems can ma lus kun: 'khor ba'i duḥkha las thar phyir: ye shes lha yi dkyil 'khor du:zhi bar bsnyen cing khro bor sgrub: dang po zhi bar bsnyen pa ni: 'jig rten g.yeng ba spangs pa'i sar: brtson 'grus ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: bgegs dang yul bdag tshims par byas: mtshams bcad bde ba'i stan la 'dug: las kyi rim pa 'di la 'jug: e ma: bdag gis dal 'byor rin chen 'di: u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar: phyis nas yang yang rnyed dka' bas: da res bla med don yod bya: phun tshogs rin chen lus 'di yang: mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa ltar: nam 'chi nges pa'i gding med pas: brtson 'grus drag pos byang chub bsgrub: mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che: skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug: thar dka' gting mtha' med 'di las: thar phyir dam pa'i spyad pa spyod: rang gi spyi bor pad nyi'i steng: sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma dang: dkon mchog skyabs gnas ma lus pa: sprin phung gtibs pa lta bur bsam: na mo: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: bslu med skyabs gnas thams cad la: sgo gsum dang bas skyabs su mchi: rang rig rang ngo ma shes pas: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can kun: bde chen sa la dgod bya'i phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: spros pa kun zhi chos dbyings kyi: rang mdangs zung 'jug bde ba'i sku: 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid la: bdag ni dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing: dpag yas mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod: nyes bshags dge la rjes yi rang: bla med chos 'khor bskor ba dang: mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs: bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: mchog dang thun mong siddhi stsol: gdung ba'i shugs kyis gsol ba 'debs: tshogs zhing rang dang gnyis med bsre: de ltar sngon 'gro mthar phyin nas:

rang bzhin dag pa'i sngags 'di brjod: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun: snang tsam nyid na ngo bos stong: rang bzhin chu zla lta bu la: ngo bo stong pa nyid du gnas: de yi ngang las kun snang ba'i: snying rje chen po khyab par brdal: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med las: rang byung rig pa yi ge dhī: dhīḥlas 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: de las mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rang nyid 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs: gur gum mdangs ldan gzhon nu'i tshul: phyag gnyis ral gri utpal steng: stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam bsnams: zur phud lnga pa mtshan dpe dang: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: 'od zer klong na gsal ba yi: thugs kar sems dpa' tshon gang gi: nang du zla steng dhīḥyig la: gsang sngags phreng bas 'khor bar bsam: ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim: dbang bskur rgyas gdab byin gyis brlabs: yengs med bzlas pa 'di la 'bad: āoṃ a ra pa tsa na dhī: thun mthar ye shes lha la bstod: chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin las: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas: 'gro ba'i nyon mongs 'joms mdzad pa'i: 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo: khyod mtshan thos dang dran pas kyang: nyon mongs rtog pa kun zhi nas: ye shes snang ba rgyas pa dang: chos dbyings chen por byang chub shog: de ltar bskyed rim la 'bad nas: rdzogs rim snying po'i don la bslab: de ltar bskyed pa'i lha de kun: ngo bo rang gi rig pa ste: de las 'gag med mdangs su shar: gang shar chos nyid rol pa la: spang blang dgag bsgrub re dogs med: ji ltar mtsho yi rlabs bzhin du: ngang las shar zhing ngang du grol: skye med bsam yul kun las 'das: 'di yin bza' gtad phyogs ris bral: thams cad rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang: 'gyur med don gyi chos sku 'o:

rjes ni shis brjod smon lam bya: dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo: 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhi bar bsnyen pa'i man ngag rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: padma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal gyis yar klungs shel phug gi byang 'dab rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i brag gi ngos nas spyan drangs pa'o// //
